meal.title: Generating a Random Slot Machine Spin
meal.objective: Build columns of random symbols without repeats using lists and random.choice

voice.script: What if every spin was truly random? How do we generate columns of symbols without repeats? First, we need a function that creates the spin. We'll call it get_slot_machine_spin. This function will take the symbol counts dictionary and the number of columns we want. Inside, we build each column by picking three symbols at random, making sure we don't pick the same symbol twice in that column. We use random.choice to select a symbol from a list that reflects its frequency. Now let's write the function. Each column is built by looping three times and adding a chosen symbol to a temporary list, then we collect all columns into a master list. Running the script prints three columns of symbols. A list lets you collect random symbols for each reel. Try changing the number of columns or symbols to see different results.
